arxiv-2109-05301.title: Operator Delocalization in Quantum Networks
arxiv-2109-05301.creator: Joonho Kim, Jeff Murugan, Jan Olle, Dario Rosa
arxiv-2109-05301.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Joonho Kim, Jeff Murugan, Jan Olle, Dario Rosa. We investigate the delocalization of operators in non-chaotic quantum systems whose interactions are encoded in an underlying graph or network. In particular, we study how fast operators of different sizes delocalize as the network connectivity is varied. We argue that these delocalization properties are well captured by Krylov complexity and show, numerically, that efficient delocalization of large operators can only happen within sufficiently connected network topologies.

arxiv-2110-00353.title: Kinetic Coupling Corrected Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet Gravity Late-Time Phenomenology
arxiv-2110-00353.creator: F.P. Fronimos
arxiv-2110-00353.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by F.P. Fronimos. In this short note we present the dynamics of a general scalar-tensor model, and in particular a scalar Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet model with a non-minimal coupling between gravity and the kinetic term of the scalar field.

arxiv-2209-02602.title: A spatial variance-smoothing area level model for small area estimation of demographic rates
arxiv-2209-02602.creator: Peter A. Gao, Jon Wakefield
arxiv-2209-02602.description: Abstract Accurate estimates of subnational health and demographic indicators are critical for informing health policy decisions. Many countries collect relevant data using complex household surveys, but when data are limited, direct survey weighted estimates of small area proportions may be unreliable.

arxiv-2211-06739.title: Partial Binarization of Neural Networks for Budget-Aware Efficient Learning
arxiv-2211-06739.creator: Udbhav Bamba, Neeraj Anand, Saksham Aggarwal, Dilip K. Prasad, Deepak K. Gupta
arxiv-2211-06739.description: Abstract Binarization is a powerful compression technique for neural networks, significantly reducing FLOPs, but often results in a significant drop in model performance. To address this issue, partial binarization techniques have been developed, but a systematic approach to mixing binary and full-precision parameters in a single network is still lacking.

arxiv-2308-10238.title: Thompson Sampling for Real-Valued Combinatorial Pure Exploration of Multi-Armed Bandit
arxiv-2308-10238.creator: Shintaro Nakamura, Masashi Sugiyama
arxiv-2308-10238.description: Abstract We study the real-valued combinatorial pure exploration of the multi-armed bandit (R-CPE-MAB) problem. In R-CPE-MAB, a player is given d d stochastic arms, and the reward of each arm s ∈ { 1 , … , d } s\in\{1,\ldots,d\} follows an unknown distribution with mean μ s \mu_{s} .

arxiv-2308-14616.title: VoroMesh: Learning Watertight Surface Meshes with Voronoi Diagrams
arxiv-2308-14616.creator: Nissim Maruani, Roman Klokov, Maks Ovsjanikov, Pierre Alliez, Mathieu Desbrun
arxiv-2308-14616.description: Abstract In stark contrast to the case of images, finding a concise, learnable discrete representation of 3D surfaces remains a challenge. In particular, while polygon meshes are arguably the most common surface representation used in geometry processing, their irregular and combinatorial structure often make them unsuitable for learning-based applications.

arxiv-2312-07288.title: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces in 6G Radio Localization: A Survey of Recent Developments, Opportunities, and Challenges
arxiv-2312-07288.creator: Anum Umer, Ivo Müürsepp, Muhammad Mahtab Alam, Henk Wymeersch
arxiv-2312-07288.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Anum Umer, Ivo Müürsepp, Muhammad Mahtab Alam, Henk Wymeersch. In this survey paper, we present an extensive review of the use of reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS) in 6G radio localization, highlighting their pivotal role as a low-cost, energy-efficient technology that reshapes wireless communication and localization landscapes.

arxiv-2501-03985.title: Exploring the evolution of a dwarf spheroidal galaxy with SPH simulations: II. AGN feedback
arxiv-2501-03985.creator: Roberto Hazenfratz, Paramita Barai, Gustavo A. Lanfranchi, Anderson Caproni
arxiv-2501-03985.description: Abstract We investigate AGN feedback from an intermediate-mass black hole at the center of a dwarf spheroidal galaxy, by performing isolated galaxy simulations using a modified version of the GADGET-3 code. We consider Leo II (PGC 34176) in the Local Group as our simulation reference model.

arxiv-2501-10035.title: Mapping scientific communities at scale
arxiv-2501-10035.creator: Victor Barbier, Eric Jeangirard
arxiv-2501-10035.description: Abstract This study introduces a novel methodology for mapping scientific communities at scale, addressing challenges associated with network analysis in large bibliometric datasets. By leveraging enriched publication metadata from the French research portal scanR and applying advanced filtering techniques to prioritize the strongest interactions between entities, we construct detailed, scalable network maps.

arxiv-2502-05539.title: SSH: Sparse Spectrum Adaptation via Discrete Hartley Transformation
arxiv-2502-05539.creator: Yixian Shen, Qi Bi, Jia-Hong Huang, Hongyi Zhu, Andy D. Pimentel, Anuj Pathania
arxiv-2502-05539.description: Abstract Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has been demonstrated effective in reducing the trainable parameter number when fine-tuning a large foundation model (LLM). However, it still encounters computational and memory challenges when scaling to larger models or addressing more complex task adaptation.

pmc-10532241.title: Minimal Clinically Important Difference (MCID) in the Functional Status Measures in Patients with Stroke: Inverse Probability Treatment Weighting
pmc-10532241.creator: Yu-Chien Chang, Hsiu-Fen Lin, Yu-Fu Chen, Hong-Yaw Chen, Yu-Tsz Shiu, Hon-Yi Shi, Dmitriy Atochin, Georgios Tsivgoulis
pmc-10532241.description: This study proposed to evaluate the temporal trend, define the minimal clinically important difference (MCID) for five functional status measures, and identify risk factors for reaching deterioration in the MCID. This prospective cohort study analyzed 680 patients with ischemic stroke and 151 patients with hemorrhagic stroke at six hospitals between April 2015 and October 2021.

pmc-10570728.creator: Zhang Huangwei, Jin Peiyuan, Kong Yixuan, Yang Zhimin, Zhou Yuxin, Jung Geunhwa, Hu Jian
pmc-10570728.description: Emerging multidrug resistance (MDR) in Clarireedia spp. is a huge challenge to the management of dollar spot (DS) disease on turfgrass. Insight into the molecular basis of resistance mechanisms may help identify key molecular targets for developing novel effective chemicals. Previously, a MDR isolate (LT586) of C.

pmc-10637979.title: Patient-Reported Health-Related Quality of Life in KEYNOTE-604: Pembrolizumab or Placebo Added to Etoposide and Platinum as First-Line Therapy for Extensive-Stage SCLC
pmc-10637979.creator: Hye Ryun Kim, Mark M Awad, Alejandro Navarro, Maya Gottfried, Solange Peters, Tibor Csőszi, Parneet K Cheema, Delvys Rodriguez-Abreu, Mirjana Wollner, James Chih-Hsin Yang, Julien Mazieres, Francisco J Orlandi, Alexander Luft, Mahmut Gümüş, Terufumi Kato, Gregory P Kalemkerian, Yiwen Luo, Melissa L
pmc-10637979.description: IntroductionIn the phase 3 KEYNOTE-604 study (NCT03066778), pembrolizumab plus etoposide and platinum chemotherapy (EP) significantly (p = 0.0023) improved progression-free survival versus placebo plus EP in previously untreated extensive-stage SCLC (ES-SCLC). We present health-related quality of life (HRQoL) results from KEYNOTE-604.

pmc-11343725.title: Clinical, Pathologic, and Dosimetric Predictors of Head and Neck Lymphedema Following Definitive or Adjuvant Radiation Therapy for Head and Neck Cancer
pmc-11343725.creator: Kevin R. Rogacki, P. Troy Teo, Mahesh Gopalakrishnan, Suvidya Lakshmi Pachigolla, Clayton E. Lyons, Mohamed E. Abazeed, Indra Das, Bharat B. Mittal, Michelle Gentile
pmc-11343725.description: PurposeHead and neck lymphedema (HNL) following radiation therapy for head and neck cancer (HNC) causes patient morbidity. Predicting individual patients’ risk of HNL after treatment is challenging. We aimed to identify the demographic, disease-related, and treatment-related factors associated with external and internal HNL following treatment of HNC with definitive or adjuvant radiation therapy.

pmc-11673026.title: Coupling Up: A Dynamic Investigation of Romantic Partners’ Neurobiological States During Nonverbal Connection
pmc-11673026.creator: Cailee M. Nelson, Christian O’Reilly, Mengya Xia, Caitlin M. Hudac
pmc-11673026.description: Nonverbal connection is an important aspect of everyday communication. For romantic partners, nonverbal connection is essential for establishing and maintaining feelings of closeness. EEG hyperscanning offers a unique opportunity to examine the link between nonverbal connection and neural synchrony among romantic partners.

pmc-12631409.title: Review and analysis of clinical trials of selective RET inhibitors for the treatment of thyroid cancer
pmc-12631409.creator: Yulu Zhou, Junjie Cao, Siqi Zhang, Mingjun Sun, Yaqi Zhang, Songzhe Li, Zining Luo, Pengyu Wang, Jiebin Xie
pmc-12631409.description: The global incidence of thyroid cancer has increased significantly, and patients with advanced, recurrent, or radioiodine-refractory disease face a severe shortage of effective treatment options. The RET proto-oncogene serves as a key driver in the development of thyroid cancer, and its alterations are closely associated with highly aggressive tumor subtypes.

pmc-12749294.title: The hydrogen-to-carbon mole perspective reveals cleanness and inequality of global and national fossil fuel transition
pmc-12749294.creator: Guobao Song, Xinyue Zhao, Yu Zhang, Lin Lv, Dabo Guan, Gang Liu
pmc-12749294.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Transition away from fossil fuels concerns both carbon and hydrogen as the main energy carriers in different hydrocarbons, but the current energy transition literature primarily emphasizes carbon, with limited attention to hydrogen embedded in fossil fuels. Here we introduce the index of Hydrogen-to-Carbon Mole Ratio (HCR) to measure the clean transition and inequality of global and national fossil fuel consumption, production, export, and import over nearly four decades (1980-2016).

pmc-12777783.title: Long non-coding RNA NEAT1 mediated lupus nephritis induced podocytes pyroptosis through DNMT1–STING axis
pmc-12777783.creator: Yi Zeng, Zhen-Kun He, Yun-Juan Liao, Ang Ma, Cheng Li, Ping Fu
pmc-12777783.description: Lupus nephritis (LN), a severe complication of systemic lupus erythematosus, is characterized by podocyte injury mediated through autoantibody deposition, yet the underlying mechanisms remain incompletely understood. This study investigated the role of long non-coding RNA nuclear enriched abundant transcript 1 (NEAT1) in podocyte pyroptosis and its interaction with the stimulator of interferon genes (STING) pathway.

pmc-12927515.title: Prognostic Significance of Up-to-Seven Criteria Versus Milan Criteria for Hepatocellular Carcinoma Patients Undergoing Resection or Locoregional Therapy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-12927515.creator: Ni Putu Sri Indrani Remitha, I Komang Wira Ananta Kusuma, I Gede Aswin Parisya Sasmana, I Gede Putu Supadmanaba, Dwijo Anargha Sindhughosa, I Ketut Mariadi
pmc-12927515.description: Introduction:Every year, the incidence of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) rises, making it a persistent global health concern. To help patients with HCC make treatment options for transplant eligibility, a number of selection criteria, including the Milan and Up-to-Seven criteria, have been developed; however, it is unclear how well these predict outcomes.

pmc-13037592.title: Effects of supplementation with rumen-protected methionine on growth, feed efficiency, blood parameters, and health of weaned Holstein growing calves
pmc-13037592.creator: Hamed Nikookalm, Farhad Foroudi, Naser Karimi, Ghobad Asgari, Kazem Karimi, Ali Afsar
pmc-13037592.description: Objective: This study evaluated the effects of dietary supplementation with rumen-protected methionine (RPM) on growth performance, feed efficiency (FE), blood parameters, and health status in post-weaning calves. Materials and Methods: Forty weaned calves were randomly allocated to four groups: G1. No RPM supplementation (control); G2. RPM supplementation for 10 days post-weaning (days 75–85); G3.

pmc-13399917.title: L‐Shaped Three‐Portal Configuration for Arthroscopic Double‐Row Suture Repair of Lafosse Type III and IV Subscapularis Tears
pmc-13399917.creator: Gang Li, Feifei Shen, Wei Sun, Shaobo Li, Dedong Cui, Hui Luan, Xingtao Ge
pmc-13399917.description: Lafosse type III and IV subscapularis tendon injuries are severe rotator cuff tears. Current repair uses anterolateral, anterior, and lateral portals, which have restricted visualization and difficult maneuverability. This technical note describes an L‐shaped three‐portal (LST) combination: anterosuperolateral, anteroinferolateral, and anteroinferomedial portals. The L‐shaped three‐portal configuration establishes an unobstructed surgical field free from bony interference, allowing comprehensive subscapularis tendon exposure.
